K.frozen: there is no replayed stage system on which P1 exhausts the Krylov budget and S does not (subset), in any cell, along either trajectory
K.systems_where_the_kernels_differ_columns: cell, trajectory, attempt, stage, h bits (the attempt's step), the driver's own outcome (C completed, B budget, O other linear error, E other error), shipped and P1 codes (Arnoldi columns of an iterate, -1 budget, -2 other error)

V.frozen: 0 violations of the stage threshold by a completed P1 solve in the replay

T.frozen: over the 320 pairs, d = exhausting solves of P1 minus those of S; W = number of pairs with d > 0, n = number of pairs with d != 0; T holds iff P(X >= W) >= 0.05, X ~ Bin(n, 1/2) (n = 0: holds)
T.per_pair_note: attempts = accepted + rejected of the run; E = max_i |y_i(t1) - ref_i| / (1 + |ref_i|) against the unperturbed reference of the family (not corrected for the perturbation of the start, relative 1e-8); attempts_ratio and error_ratio are P1 / S
